A separate slip wrote stale AO-MA-11H evidence into this file (inherited from main); it was rewritten with this slice's real scope before the gate ran.

Fail-closed, recompute-not-trust (the core of the three review rounds): (1) test-report all_passed is derived from the totals and a forged flag is rejected by _report_is_green; (2) closeout slice_passed=True requires the bound report green by its OWN totals AND the suggestion register closed (complete with coverage, or no_objections with expected 0) AND every sibling carrying the closeout's slice_id -- both build_closeout and verify_closeout_binding enforce this, so a digest match alone cannot launder a forged-green report or an in_progress register or a cross-slice sibling; (3) verify_bundle_manifest matches role + artifact_kind + schema_version + sha256 + line_count against the recomputed set (right-sha+wrong-kind and missing/duplicate members are rejected); (4) an empty suggestion register requires an explicit expected_objections_count=0 (no implicit 'no records means no objections'); (5) skipped tests do not count as a pass (required_tests_present gate); (6) reject/partial objections require a rationale, accept requires an applied_ref or a no-op rationale.

Secret-safe + tamper-evident: every free-text field (objection text, rationale, ledger summary, suite name) is machine-redacted via a notifier-grade denylist before entering an artifact, and the suggestion register asserts no_secret_payload only after that redaction. canonical_bytes is the single pinned serialization (sort_keys + ensure_ascii=False + compact separators + one trailing newline) so sha256 is stable; verify_closeout_binding and verify_bundle_manifest re-hash and re-check (machine recompute, not self-attestation). The closeout binds the three siblings; the manifest references the closeout (one-way), so there is no circular hash.

Purity is structurally guaranteed by an AST import-allowlist test (only hashlib/json/re/dataclasses/typing/__future__ may be imported): a forbidden module (subprocess/os/socket/requests/httpx/urllib/a GitHub or LLM client) cannot be used without importing it, so the allowlist is the binding guarantee.

Local gate green: 49 tests pass; slice_evidence_registers.py near-100% branch coverage; full suite 5062 tests / 0 failures / 0 errors / 76 skipped (verified via JUnit XML, not a hand-typed count); five schemas Draft 2020-12 valid; ruff + mypy clean. No existing behavior changed -- all-new schemas + module + tests + plan doc + evidence. A dead duplicated block in _require_nonneg_int found during the coverage pass was removed.

No secrets, tokens, credential material, webhook URLs, admin bypass, ruleset/branch-protection mutation, CODEOWNERS change, .github change, support widening, production platform claim, or live adapter execution are introduced. The three guard flags remain literal false across all five schemas and the module.
